editorial:
Imagine jumping twenty years into the future where humans and Worms actually try to get along. You get to see how the world has changed, but things aren't as peaceful as they seem. You'll follow Yui Kagami, the son of the legendary Gatack, as he steps into the spotlight with a brand new Rider system. It feels like a passing of the torch, mixing that old-school cool with some fresh faces. The vibe is a perfect mix of family drama and high-tech sci-fi, making you care about the characters while you wait for the next big fight scene.

The action is where this movie really shines, with the fast-paced clock-up battles looking better than ever. You will love the surprise appearances of old faces, and the plot twists keep you guessing until the very end. While the middle part slows down a bit too much with the ZECT politics, the payoff is totally worth it. You should definitely watch this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the suit details, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning your movies. It is a great ride for any fan of the franchise.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the mysterious shadow is actually a clone of Tendou, created by ZECT to be the ultimate weapon. Yui and Arata have to team up to stop him. In the final battle, Yui unlocks a new form and defeats the clone, proving he is the true heir to the heavens. The movie ends with ZECT finally being shut down for good, allowing humans and Worms to live in true peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero legacies and high-tech battles.
